newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-BMW WINS AT RAIN-SWEPT SILVERSTONE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-BMW WINS AT RAIN-SWEPT SILVERSTONE.

text.p: Dutchman Peter Kox and Italian Roberto Ravaglia were awarded victory in a dramatic second round of the FIA GT championship on Sunday after stewards stopped the race early.
The BMW McLaren team snatched the 10 points from Bernd Schneider and Alezander Wurz in a Mercedes when the rainswept race was halted with one lap to go.
Kox had started the final lap with the Mercedes pairing alongside, and the German duo passed him halfway around the track.
But almost immediately stewards stopped the race as others crashed at the final corner and the result was taken from the end of the previous lap.
"It was quite impossible to drive in these conditions," Kox said. "I cannot believe they allowed it to continue as they did. But we are happy to have won."
Finn J.J. Lehto and Britain's Steve Soper -- winners of the opening round at Hockenheim -- finished third and lead the overall standings with 14 points.
